title: Dawn routine benchsheet (personal)
content:
Dawn routine benchsheet - quick personal tracker
Purpose: nightly quick sweep for cold-start and short-session latency across small prompt loads. Keep tiny, frictionless, copyable into team bench PRs.

How I run: (1) clear KV cache, (2) run 3 warmup steps to verify model load, (3) run 5 measured queries, capture p50/p95/ms and tokens/sec, (4) annotate temp and quantization.

Checklist before run:
- env: rwinf-dev-east-2
- model artifact: v3.1-q4_0 or v3.1-fp16 (match tag)
- script: scripts/mini_sweep.py --cold --runs 5
- slack thread: #bench-dawn for quick notes

Mini results table (pipe-separated, paste to PR):
Date | run_id | model | quant | cache_state | seq_len | batch | p50_ms | p95_ms | tps | cost_est_cents | score | notes
2026-03-09 | dawn-031 | redwood/v3.1 | q4_0 | cold | 128 | 1 | 58 | 112 | 140 | 0.27 | 0.79 | slow disk attach on node3
2026-03-09 | dawn-032 | redwood/v3.1 | q4_0 | warm | 128 | 1 | 34 | 58 | 240 | 0.18 | 0.93 | normal
2026-03-09 | dawn-033 | redwood/v3.1 | fp16 | cold | 128 | 1 | 82 | 155 | 110 | 0.45 | 0.68 | fp16 cold load penalty
2026-03-10 | dawn-034 | redwood/v3.1 | q4_0 | cold | 256 | 1 | 120 | 210 | 100 | 0.38 | 0.71 | longer seq hurts p95
2026-03-10 | dawn-035 | redwood/v3.1 | q4_0 | warm | 256 | 2 | 92 | 160 | 220 | 0.34 | 0.86 | batch=2 helps throughput

Quick observations (bullet notes):
- q4_0 gives consistently lower cost and good p50 once warmed; cold-start delta typically +60-80% on p95 versus warm.
- fp16 shows flashier fps when warmed but much higher cold-start overhead (GPU mmap + kernel JIT).
- batch=2 often gives best tokens/sec for seq >=256 but watch p95 tail.

Short TODOs / experiments to try next dawn:
- run on dedicated pool (dedicated-east-1) to see if cold attach goes away
- trace with console tracing for dawn-034 where p95 jumped
- quick eval: rerank prompts randomly for dawn-035 to ensure quality didn't regress with batching

Failure modes to capture (keep here for quick copy):
- node attach timeouts (node3) -> escalate to infra if >3 occurrences in 24h
- OOMs on warm loads at seq>512 -> reduce batch or switch to fp16

Pocket math (cost approximations):
- cost_est_cents = (tokens_generated * model_rate_per_1k_tokens_cents) / 1000 approximations I use: q4_0 ~ 0.27c per 1k tokens, fp16 ~ 0.45c per 1k tokens.
- quick check: 200 tokens * 0.27 / 1000 = 0.054 cents per request -> multiply by qps for minute cost.

Notes-to-self format for PRs: copy the two best lines (warm + cold) and paste under Results, add one-liner obs. Example snippet for PR: 
- Warm cold-start snapshots: p50=34ms (warm), p95=112ms (cold) on q4_0, seq=128, batch=1. Observed cold disk attach on node3 leading to 40% extra p95.

End of sheet. Keep small, delete old days if >30 entries.
